profile_text.body:
Appian Corp is a public company, ticker APPN, headquartered in McLean, Virginia, and registered with CIK 0001441683. According to its website, it provides AI automation for critical business processes, orchestrating AI agents, systems, and people on an enterprise platform without replacing a customer's existing systems. The company says it has been automating processes for more than 25 years.

The site describes the Appian Platform as a place where customers build AI-powered processes, including low-code application building with embedded AI agents that extract data, act autonomously, and generate code from natural language prompts. Listed uses include accounts payable and receivable, invoice processing and reconciliation, sourcing and supplier data, audit and compliance workflows, case management, purchase-to-pay, employee, customer and vendor onboarding, order intake and fulfillment, and contract review. The company states that onboarding time can be cut by up to 50%. It also states that it was named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies (BOAT), and it points to an AI Value Study produced with Harvard Business Review Analytic Services.

The company's legal exposure record lists Virginia, with a count of 152. No lawsuits are listed.
